_note: Only relationships stated by the publisher or a primary source are listed. Each edge must cite evidence. Types: extends, imports, part-of, aligns-with, superseded-by, references, follows-pattern-of.

types.label: extends
types.description: Specialises or builds on the target's concepts.

types.label: part of
types.description: Published as a module of the same standard or suite.

types.label: aligns with
types.description: Provides an alignment or mapping to the target.

types.label: integrated into
types.description: Content was integrated into, or is continued by, the target.

types.label: references
types.description: Uses identifiers or terms from the target.

evidence.note: The W3C/OGC Recommendation defines SOSA as the lightweight core that SSN builds on and imports.
ETSI TS 103 410-3: SAREF extension for buildings.
ETSI TS 103 410-1: SAREF extension for energy.
IEEE 1872-2015 builds CORA on SUMO as its upper ontology.
The IEEE 1872-2015 axiomatisation grounds the robotics ontologies in SUMO.
Alignment layer between SUMO and CORA.
CORAX is specified in IEEE 1872-2015 together with CORA.
POS (position ontology) is specified in IEEE 1872-2015.
IEEE 1872.2-2021 extends CORA with autonomous-robotics ontologies.
All IOF ontologies are grounded in BFO 2020.
The Common Core Ontologies are a mid-level extension of BFO.
The OEO README states that the ontology makes use of, and follows the principles of, the Basic Formal Ontology.
GoodRelations was integrated into schema.org in 2012.
The GS1 Web Vocabulary is designed as an extension of schema.org product terms.
VSSo follows the SOSA/SSN pattern for observations and actuations.
AAS semantic IDs commonly reference ECLASS IRDIs; see the AAS metamodel specification.
ETSI states SAREF4BLDG is created based on the Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) standard.
